verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at developers.kit.com that indexes markdown versions of the docs, and many doc pages are served as .md. Kit also ships a first-party Developer Docs MCP server that gives coding agents real-time access to its documentation, so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs directly. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (the openapi probes returned 404), and no independent hands-on report of agents using these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: gives AI coding agents direct, real-time access to Kit's developer documentation. Rather than copying and pasting docs into your AI client, your agent can query Kit's full API reference
It queries the live docs so your agent stops working from a cached or hallucinated API surface.
